name: Parks Signs
description:
This dataset contains records of signs installed in public parks, with one row per sign. Each record describes the sign's type (mostly consolidated rules signs, plus routed, wayfinding, and other signs), its sign code, the languages displayed, the mounting surface (such as chain link fence, wrought iron fence, wall, or free-standing), its status (installed or surveyed), and its posted hours where available. Each sign is tied to a park property and location, including property and sub-property names, street location, borough, community board, council district, park district, police precinct, ZIP code, and a geographic point. The data also includes codes for the primary, second, and third languages on each sign, with Spanish, Chinese, and Russian among the most common.

The dataset can be used to map sign locations across the city, audit multilingual signage coverage by neighborhood or district, track installed versus surveyed signs for maintenance and inventory purposes, and study equity in park information resources. Planners
